MEDIA TECHNOLOGY — TERMLY EXAM #1
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: MEDIA TECHNOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Media Ownership and Management P, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Media Ownership and Management P.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Media Ownership and Management P.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Media Ownership and Management P.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepreneurship 3.1 Media Ownership and Management P.

2. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Ignore burnt cables
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Never touch live wires with wet hands

3. When learning Introduction to Media Technology, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Media Technology.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Media Technology.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Media Technology.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Media Technology.

4. When learning Post- production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Post- production.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Post- production.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Post- production.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Post- production.

5. When learning Post-Production 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photography 2.2 Digital Video Productio, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Post-Production 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photography 2.2 Digital Video Productio.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Post-Production 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photography 2.2 Digital Video Productio.

6. When learning Digital Video Production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Digital Video Production.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Digital Video Production.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Digital Video Production.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Digital Video Production.

7. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Speaker
   B. CPU
   C. Keyboard
   D. Monitor

8. When learning Introduction to Media Technology 1.2 Pre-Production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-Prod, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Media Technology 1.2 Pre-Production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-Prod.

   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Media Technology 1.2 Pre-Production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-Prod.

9. When learning Photography, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Photography.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Photography.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Photography.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Photography.

10. When learning Pre - Production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Pre - Production.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Pre - Production.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Pre - Production.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Pre - Production.

11. When learning Pre-Production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-Production 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photo, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Pre-Production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-Production 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photo.

   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Audio Production.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Audio Production.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Audio Production.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Audio Production.

13. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Work alone with eyes closed
   B. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   C. Run with the tool
   D. Remove all guards

14. When learning Production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Production.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Production.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Production.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Production.

15. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Internal Cooking Timer
   B. Input Cable Tester
   C. International Cricket Team

16. When learning Photography 2.2 Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepre, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   D. Skip safety briefings for Photography 2.2 Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepre.

----
